visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle shot of a vast automated warehouse. Several massive industrial fans are mounted on vertical support pillars. Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) carrying brown cardboard boxes navigate along floor tracks in a brightly lit industrial setting. (2) A box passes through a scanning gate within a transparent enclosure; a digital screen nearby displays numerical data and Chinese text. (3) A close-up of a white AGV with blue light strips and the "OMEGA Geek+" logo carrying a wooden pallet stacked with plastic-wrapped goods. (4) An AGV moves into a shelving area, overlaid with a technical graphic of a boxer engine and text labels like 'Manufacturer A' and 'Manufacturer B' in Chinese. (5) A vertical lift mechanism is seen from a low angle, moving pallets between multi-tiered metal storage racks. (6) A man in his 30s with a blue denim shirt and a black cap appears, speaking directly toward the camera within the warehouse environment. (7) A high-speed shot down a narrow aisle shows automated shuttles moving horizontally through the shelving marked with numbers. (8) The video ends with a promotional graphic card featuring the man pointing toward text that invites viewers to watch the full unboxing of Taiwan's largest unmanned warehouse.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over an upbeat electronic pop background track featuring a driving 4/4 drum beat and synth chords. The low-level hum of industrial machinery and fans provides a constant ambient layer. (2) A subtle digital 'beep' sound occurs as packages pass through sensors, followed by a transition 'whoosh'. The narrator's speech is fast-paced and clear, detailing logistical capabilities. (3) A mechanical clacking sound is heard as shuttles move on tracks. The music intensity remains constant as the narrator shifts to an analogy about engine principles to explain warehouse trading logic. (4) The narrator’s tone becomes more direct and conversational while the machinery hum swells slightly. Digital UI sound effects punctuate the explanation of 'digital transportation'. (5) A final crescendo in the music leads to a clean fade, ending with a short percussive beat that coincides with the call to action on the end card.
